api_key.description: An ObjectiveAI API Key. The format is always `apk` followed by 32 hexadecimal characters.

created.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was created.

expires.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key expires, or null if it does not expire.

disabled.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was disabled, or null if it is not disabled.

name.description: The name of the API key.

description.description: The description of the API key, or null if no description was provided.

description: An ObjectiveAI API Key with metadata.
